title: Where along the spine each corpus lies
caption: One strip per corpus from C1 to the coccyx, shaded by the corpus's image count where its record gives one and outlined where only the region is known, with a band counting the corpora at each level. Read where the holding is thick (lumbar, sacrum) and where it is thin (cervical and thoracic on real frames).
status: a record, not a final value

source.notes: Drawn new from committed files. The counts are the records' own (Reported); the data type, the span along the spine and the tried status of each corpus are the chapter's reading of each record, written into corpora-overlay.json (Inferred); the script refuses any count its record or the overlay's note does not give. Some counts drawn are held open by the contradictions pages or the concept ledger (C-ArmLSpine's 149 cases, TotalSegmentator v3's 1,935 scans, NHANES II's 16,531 films), so the figure is a record, not a final value, and its notes say so beside each. The artifact named is the earlier rendering of the same records.
